activities.instructions: Ayuda a la rana a cruzar el río eligiendo el nenúfar correcto en cada salto.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Manager: You may wish to review the figures. Analyst: ___

options.text: Thank you. I will check them carefully.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta acepta la recomendación con cortesía.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence is a professional alternative to I can't come to the meeting?

options.text: I will be unable to attend the meeting.

rounds.explanation: I will be unable to attend expresa la misma información con tono profesional.

rounds.prompt: A letter begins Dear Sir or Madam. Which closing normally matches it?
rounds.explanation: Yours faithfully se usa habitualmente después de un saludo sin nombre.

rounds.prompt: Which phrase politely replaces I want a refund in a complaint?

options.text: I would like to request a refund.

rounds.explanation: I would like to request... mantiene la petición y suaviza el tono.

rounds.prompt: How should a manager rewrite Stop making mistakes in client emails?

options.text: Please take greater care when writing to clients.

rounds.explanation: Please take greater care es una corrección profesional y accionable.

rounds.prompt: Consultant: The timetable was revised. Client: ___

options.text: Thank you for notifying me. I will update my records.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta reconoce el cambio y comunica la acción posterior.

rounds.prompt: Which phrase politely challenges a decision without sounding aggressive?

options.text: I would appreciate clarification regarding this decision.
This decision makes no sense, mate.

rounds.explanation: I would appreciate clarification... abre una consulta diplomática.

rounds.prompt: Student: Could you let me know the deadline? Office: ___

options.text: The completed form is due on 30 June.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta ofrece la información solicitada de manera clara y formal.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Colócate en el carril de la respuesta correcta antes de cruzar cada puerta.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Editor: The financial implications require consideration. Writer: ___

options.text: I agree. I will add a cost analysis to the report.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta acepta la observación y propone una acción concreta.

rounds.prompt: Director: The launch may be postponed. Assistant: ___

options.text: I understand. I will prepare both schedules.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta reconoce la posibilidad sin convertirla en certeza.

rounds.prompt: Reviewer: This proposal appears impractical. Author: ___

options.text: I appreciate the feedback. Could you indicate which aspect requires revision?
It is fine, end of story.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta agradece el comentario y solicita una aclaración constructiva.

rounds.prompt: Which connector best replaces so in a formal explanation of a result?
rounds.explanation: Consequently expresa resultado con registro formal.

rounds.prompt: Supplier: The delivery may be delayed. Buyer: ___

options.text: Thank you for informing us. Please keep us updated.

rounds.explanation: La respuesta reconoce el aviso y solicita información posterior con cortesía.

rounds.prompt: The original says If you need help, call us. Which formal version keeps the same condition?

options.text: Should you require assistance, please contact us.
Call us because help is needed.
You must call us for every reason.

rounds.explanation: Should you require... es una inversión formal equivalente a if you need.

rounds.prompt: Customer: I would like to request a refund. Agent: ___

options.text: I will look into this matter straight away.

rounds.explanation: I will look into this matter es una respuesta profesional a una queja.

rounds.prompt: How can a report politely say The figures are wrong?

options.text: The figures appear to contain an error.

rounds.explanation: Appear to contain an error señala el problema sin atacar al lector.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.
